## Description

Add the organisation state (Draft, Submitted, NeedsChanges, Approved, Rejected, Suspended) to the tenant and check it in IStaffAccess for every capability, replacing LicenceRules and the licencePending session flag. Proposal: until Approved the owner can set up the organisation and add staff and doctors, but patient registration, booking, check-in, notes, prescriptions and signing are refused by the server, and staff see a "waiting for approval" notice. Suspended refuses new registration, booking and signing but keeps existing records readable for care. Alternative if legal prefers it: status page only until Approved.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given an organisation that is not Approved, when any user calls a patient, booking, check-in, note or signing endpoint, then the API refuses (403) and the attempt is audited.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the organisation is Approved, when the same call is made, then it works as before.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given an organisation is Suspended, when staff open an existing record, then it is readable and new registration, booking and signing are refused.
- [ ] **AC4.** The gate is covered by integration tests on a real database under row-level security and shown to fail when the check is removed (mutation check).
- [ ] **AC5.** The shell shows a plain notice per state in English and Arabic; state is never conveyed by colour alone.

## Notes / open questions

- Reuses the capability gate in IStaffAccess; ADR-016 sizes this at about 4 days.
